title: Socket isolation and object boundary
summary: WebSocket consumes an already-authorised stream. It must not acquire RxSock, TLS or any native carrier directly, and it must preserve WebSocket and SocketAddress objects rather than flattening them into transport strings.
invariants: WebSocketAccess obtains a stream through SocketProvider~streamSender[At]() and SocketStreamAdapter.
WebSocketConnection and WebSocketMessage remain full ooRexx objects at the application boundary.
The underlying SocketAddress object remains authoritative; do not reduce it to host:port metadata.
Applications must not grow separate WebSocket-specific TCP/TLS ownership, routing, policy or credential paths.
